description: Optional customer-hosted logs and Kubernetes events for KrevoPilot (pilot)

The Plone 6 backend (Zope with the plone.restapi REST API that Volto talks to), with ZODB FileStorage on a PVC or RelStorage on PostgreSQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
